headline: Lite-On spends NT$5.5 billion to expand AI liquid cooling footprint, acquires 25% stake in DCX - Liberty Financial
summary: Lite-On Technology said it is acquiring a 25% stake in DCX Liquid Cooling Systems, a Polish liquid cooling thermal management provider, for about US$176 million (NT$5.578 billion). The deal expands its AI liquid cooling footprint.
why: Lite-On is a Taiwan-listed electronics manufacturer with a broad component and power business. Liquid cooling is a growing supply segment for AI data centers, where heat from dense server racks is a key constraint.
